subject: Exemption intake API/webhook - Bright Supply onboarding
messages:
From: Lara Cho <lara.cho@brightsupply.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: tax@brightsupply.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exemption intake - onboarding Bright Supply (reseller)

Hi Priyom,

We're starting the reseller onboarding for Bright Supply Co. — attached is our signed state resale certificate (BrightSupply_ResaleCert_2024.pdf). We need Redwood to accept our certificate so charges to our account are applied tax-exempt for applicable ship‑tos in TX, KS, and MN.

Quick details:
- Entity: Bright Supply Co.
- Billing EIN: 12-3456789
- Ship‑to addresses in TX, KS, MN (listed in the attachment)

Can you confirm what format you need and whether you can accept via an API/webhook? We've automated intake a bit on our side and could push a webhook + PDF if that speeds validation. Also send any exception or hold policies that would cause invoices to remain taxable.

Thanks,
Lara Cho
Head of Procurement
Bright Supply Co.
lara.cho@brightsupply.com

Attachment: BrightSupply_ResaleCert_2024.pdf (application/pdf, 312KB)

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Lara Cho <lara.cho@brightsupply.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exemption intake - onboarding Bright Supply (reseller)

Hi Lara — thanks for sending this over and for offering the webhook. Short answers up front: yes, we support automated intake (API or webhook) and we can accept PDFs. We'll need: the signed certificate (you provided), the EIN on file for billing (we'll validate against state registries), and a list of ship‑to postal codes to map coverage.

Next steps I'd propose:
1) I'll kick off a validation pass on the attached certificate and check it against the TX/KS/MN registries. If there are any mismatches we'll put the billing account in an "invoice hold for evidence" state and notify you.
2) If you'd like automated intake, please send one webhook payload per EIN with the PDF as multipart/form-data to our intake endpoint. I'll send the endpoint details to your engineering contact privately.

Jonas and Marcus — looping you for review of the acceptance criteria and to confirm the webhook consumer SLA (we try to validate within 48 business hours; exceptions if manual signatory checks required).

I'll report back with the validation result and any gaps by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Priyom Das
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Exemption intake - onboarding Bright Supply (internal)

----- Forwarded message -----
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exemption intake - onboarding Bright Supply (reseller)

Priyom — quick thoughts after looking at the PDF and the EIN: the certificate is signed and looks legible, but the EIN on the resale cert (12-3456789) does not match the EIN in our billing profile for account BRIGHT-7894 (we have 12-3456798). That could be a simple data entry issue (transposed digits) or indicate that the certificate is for a related legal entity.

I took a screenshot of the TX certificate registry query (attached: BrightSupply_EIN_Verification_Screenshot.png) — TX returns the entity name and EIN that match the certificate, but the payment profile is different. We should:
- Confirm the legal entity chain (is BRIGHT-7894 the parent or a subsidiary?)
- If the certificate covers the entity that appears on the TX registry but not our billing EIN, ask for a W9/affiliate confirmation to prove authorized billing relationship or have the customer add the certificate to the exact billing EIN in our system.

Operationally, if we can't reconcile within 3 business days we'll need to hold tax-exempt treatment for invoices originating from the mismatched billing EIN and notify finance. That's our standard: allow 3 business days for customer remediation before invoice hold transitions to tax-paid.

Jonas Weber
Tax & Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachment: BrightSupply_EIN_Verification_Screenshot.png (image/png, 98KB)

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Lara Cho <lara.cho@brightsupply.com>, tax@brightsupply.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exemption intake - onboarding Bright Supply (reseller)

Hi Lara — quick update and asks after our internal validation:

What we validated:
- The uploaded resale certificate is signed and valid for the entity name shown.
- TX registry matches the certificate EIN and legal name (see attached screenshot).

Gaps we need you to close (to prevent invoice hold):
1) Confirm which legal entity should be the chargeable billing entity for Redwood invoices (EIN 12-3456789 from the certificate vs. billing EIN 12-3456798 on account BRIGHT-7894). If the certificate is for a related subsidiary, please either: (a) update your billing profile to the certificate EIN, or (b) provide an affiliate attestation or W-9 that explicitly authorizes BRIGHT-7894 to claim exemption under that certificate.
2) Provide the list of ship‑to postal codes you expect exemption to apply to (we need these to map to state nexus).

We can support automated intake via webhook — if your engineering team prefers that route, have them POST multipart/form-data to: https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/exemptions/intake/webhook with one payload per EIN. Include: invoice_account_id, billing_ein, shipto_postal_codes (array), and the PDF. We'll respond with a 202 and a validation-id; our SLA is start-validation within 48 business hours.

If we don't receive the requested reconciling documents within 3 business days (by 2027-06-04 end of day PT), we'll place tax treatment for the current billing EIN on hold and resume only after evidence is accepted.

Action items summary:
- Bright Supply: confirm billing EIN or upload W-9/affiliate attestation; send ship‑to postal code list; optionally switch to webhook intake.
- Redwood (assigned): Jonas will review attestation if provided; Marcus will confirm invoice hold procedures and escalate to finance if needed.

If you'd like, I can schedule a short 20-minute call this week with Jonas and Marcus to walk through the evidence flow and the webhook payload example.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
